description: Fictional area-level features; IDs are custom, not Census tract identifiers. Rates are fractions.
Fictional pantry sites and capacities; coordinates are illustrative and do not identify real pantry facilities.
Typical recurring FOOD service hours in America/Chicago; not real schedules.
Food-category assumptions; all quantities elsewhere use kilograms.
104 completed Monday-Sunday weeks per pantry. Requests are synthetic observed outcomes for model targets; unavailable at prediction time. Served counts include repeat visits over time.
Weekly category requests, distribution, and unmet food quantities; reconciles to pantry history.
Inventory ledger: opening + received - distributed - expired = closing; consecutive weekly balances reconcile.
Three synthetic service events per week; attendance totals reconcile weekly. Not unique individuals or household identities.
Current synthetic batch inventory as of 2026-10-17; historical week-end stock carried forward with no assumed intervening movements. Expiry dates support first-expiring-first-out allocation.
Current category stock; identical in total to inventory_batches. Use one inventory source to avoid double counting.
Available donation pool for a what-if scenario; not yet included in pantry inventory.
Editable scenario assumptions. Pantry storage, cold storage and household service capacities are separate constraints.
